entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received a little while ago. I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF558-0912. It's for the ProFit Jersey.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 42 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The material is great, but the jersey is just way too tight across the chest.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.

Alright, I've checked the policy. Since you received the item 42 days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you and email you a shipping label right away.
Oh, that's great news. So, I can just send it back for a full refund?
That's correct. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Would you like to do an exchange for a larger size instead?

I think I'll just take the refund for now and re-order later. Thanks for processing that. Since I'll have to place a new order and pay for shipping again, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble?

I'm glad I could get the return sorted for you. I understand your request, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on returns related to sizing preference. The best I can do is get this return label sent over to you immediately so you can get your refund as quickly as possible.
Okay, that's fair. I had to ask. Please go ahead and send the label. The email on file should be correct.
Perfect. I've just sent that to you. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
